### Binding the Strong Man
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/binding-strong-man
Passage: Mark 3:27
Points:
- Jesus' exorcisms prove He attacks and overpowers Satan's kingdom rather than serving it.
- By binding the devil, Christ fulfills prophetic promises about God rescuing His captive people.
- Christ's victory continues today whenever the gospel delivers someone from spiritual darkness.
- Believers need not fear the enemy because Jesus has disarmed him and secured final victory.

### There Is No Neutral Ground with Jesus - Love Worth Finding - September 1
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-1-2026.html
Passage: Matthew 12:30
Points:
- There is no neutral position when responding to the person of Jesus Christ.
- Postponing a commitment to Christ is equivalent to rejecting Him.
- Everyone must ultimately answer Jesus with either an active yes or no.
- Failing to gather alongside Christ results in scattering against His kingdom work.
